right_flank_quips: The reports of our losses have been greatly exaggerated.
It is better to deserve a rating than to have one.
Never put off till tomorrow the touch you can score while they're still talking.
It ain't what you don't know that hurts you; it's the double touch you were sure you won.
He who speaks does not know; he who knows is already in six.
Before you seek revenge, dig two graves — preferably both on their side of the strip.
Appear weak when you are strong; appear confused when you are absolutely about to land it.
All warfare is based on deception; all epee is based on "I thought I had right-of-way."
Know yourself, know your enemy, know where you left your glove.
Softness overcomes hardness; tape overcomes everything else.
